protocol.note: Local MCP via stdio is the recommended client-launched transport (MCP 2025-06-18). Streamable HTTP + optional Mcp-Session-Id is for remote/stateless HTTP. Rhino bridge remains stateful because the live document is state.

lessons.rule: Never trust CaptureToBitmap/ViewCaptureToFile; use PrintWindow of Rhino HWND and Read the PNG.
SubD 'Creating meshes...' freezes viewport. Prefer Brep for massing. SubD CreateSubDBox sharpness>=3 for architecture.
Never RunScript interactive commands (_Zoom,_Purge,_Shaded,export). They block the UI thread. Zoom via ActiveViewport API.
One exec per stage; monolithic scripts crash Rhino 9 WIP.
Trust enumerator + names + bboxes, not Objects.Count.
Every stage: capture window, Read image, judge if it reads as architecture before continuing.

gaps: No one-shot window capture tool in MCP (added rhino_screenshot_window)
No health tool for stuck meshing / dead bridge (added rhino_health)
SubD vs Brep guidance not enforced by tools (rhino_add_box now Brep)
Streamable HTTP transport not exposed (stdio is correct for local MiMo; HTTP optional for multi-client)
